gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Distinctive Unica One draws every line as a steady, unshaded outline. Noto Sans Hebrew works underneath with a dominant midsection and wide gaps at the curve ends, so the heading's rigid outline meets a looser, more open texture.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK is sans-serif with large lowercase and lifted brush ends. Unica One holds stems and arcs in lockstep up top, while the body's open, lifted curves keep paragraphs moving smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps a c with ends splayed like pincers. Unica One is best at stating things plainly, every stroke uniform in direction, while the body is best at staying approachable and low-key across running text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Wire-like lines up top, big open eyes below. Unica One is best at announcing a page with one stubbornly uniform stroke, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian is best at settling into text with a deep middle band.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP has a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open. Noto Sans JP can sit a touch smaller beneath Unica One's marker-drawn plainness, since that height carries the line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Contemporary lettering in Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line like capitals. Across paragraphs it reads with an open channel in each e, a steady rhythm that gives Unica One's constant-width arms and legs a quiet counterpart.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Unica One's very large lowercase eye, drawn with one nib, makes its headings unmistakable. Noto Sans Kannada follows with a gentle bump up to capitals and s curves that open wide, which lets the two share a page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Clean lines from Unica One, every stroke cut to a single width. Noto Sans Kayah Li brings lifted brush ends and capitals barely taller than its lowercase, and that gentle restraint is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Contemporary lines: Unica One cuts stems and curves from one gauge of tubing. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, yet its curves never close, so extended text stays inviting.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Crisp and pressure-free, Unica One meets the wide exits of Noto Sans Khojki. And across a full page its large, clear e eyes let light through, so the reading feels modern and clean.
